summary: Rabbi Soffer addresses students learning in Eretz Yisrael, urging them to grab every moment and opportunity given to them by HaKadosh Baruch Hu to grow spiritually and learn Torah. He shares his personal journey from a working businessman who started Daf Yomi by chance to earning Semicha, becoming a community rabbi, and joining a Dayanut Kolel. He then answers questions from the students about overcoming difficulties in learning Gemara, setting goals, and balancing work with daily Torah study.
